home.tagline: PayD is the next-gen dashboard for real-time employee payments. Secure, transparent, and ultra-fast.
home.card1Body: No more waiting for banks. Pay your staff in seconds with sub-cent fees.
home.card2Body: Onboard anyone, anywhere. Pay in USDC, XLM, or local stablecoins.
home.card3Body: Full transparency. Every transaction is immutable and verifiable on-ledger.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Admin accounts can require a one-time code from an authenticator app at login.
twoFactor.statusEnabledDescription: Login requires a code from your authenticator app. You have {{count}} unused recovery codes left.
twoFactor.statusDisabledDescription: Your account is protected by a single factor only. Turn on 2FA to require a one-time code at login.
twoFactor.enableDescription: Generate a secret and scan it with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis.
twoFactor.scanDescription: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows to finish enrolling.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for setting up two-factor authentication
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Store these somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose access to your authenticator, and they are shown only now.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Enter a current code from your authenticator app. Recovery codes are not accepted here.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load your two-factor status.

twoFactor.loginDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
twoFactor.loginRecoveryHint: Lost your device? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

helpCenter.addEmployeeQuestion: How do I add an employee?
helpCenter.addEmployeeAnswer: Open the Employees page and use Add Employee to enter their details and wallet address.
helpCenter.resetPasswordQuestion: How do I reset my password?
helpCenter.resetPasswordAnswer: Use the account recovery flow from the sign-in screen or contact your organization administrator.
helpCenter.trustlineAnswer: A trustline lets a Stellar account hold a specific issued asset.
helpCenter.anchorAnswer: An anchor connects Stellar assets with traditional financial rails and local currencies.
helpCenter.payrollFailedQuestion: Why did my payroll transaction fail?
helpCenter.payrollFailedAnswer: Check the transaction status, account funding, trustlines, and network details before retrying.
helpCenter.employeeMissingAnswer: Confirm the employee is active and belongs to the organization you are viewing.
